name: title-logo-a
prompt: A film title logo that reads exactly THE SHADOW BELOW, alone on a pure solid black background (#000000) with nothing else in the picture. Custom cinematic lettering, not a plain font: tall, sharp, elegant capital letters that look carved out of cold pale light from the deep sea, white with a faint cyan-green glow at their edges; THE and SHADOW on one line, BELOW on a second line slightly larger, and under BELOW a long thin dark reflection sinking away like a shadow under water. Exactly three words, spelled T-H-E S-H-A-D-O-W B-E-L-O-W, no other words, no tagline, no border, no background texture. Landscape 3:2.
